description: This script generates a disk image (.hdd img) by assembling a boot filesystem and root filesystem based on specified sizes, offsets, and parameters. It uses external tools like 'ptgen' and 'dd' to set up the disk layout and copy filesystem images into the target image.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution logic that validates input parameters, sets variables, calculates offsets and sizes, and writes data to the target image using 'dd'.

calls: dd bs=512 if="$BOOTFS" of="$OUTPUT" seek="$BOOTOFFSET" conv=notrunc
dd bs=512 if="$ROOTFS" of="$OUTPUT" seek="$ROOTFSOFFSET" conv=notrunc
